subject: MDM / EDR / Vuln Scanner License Consolidation — Request & Next Steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: procurement@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MDM / EDR / Vuln Scanner License Consolidation — Request & Next Steps

Team,

We have three endpoint-related renewals coming up over the next 90–120 days (EDR: SentinelEdge, MDM: SecureAgent, Vuln scanner: VulnScanPro). Before we get into renewals individually, I want to explore a consolidation play to reduce agent overlap, simplify billing, and shave license costs.

Attached is the current inventory (endpoint_inventory_202605.csv) with installed agent counts and current renewal dates. Key asks:
- Can procurement start a consolidated RFP/negotiation thread with each vendor?
- Target: 20–30% total license spend reduction or equivalent net new capabilities (prefer fewer agents).
- Timeline: need vendor proposals within two weeks so we can review prior to the earliest renewal (SentinelEdge: 2026-08-15).

Mina, security constraints you care about (retention, telemetry, EDR blocking rules) — please list non-negotiables. Marissa/ Priyom — can you own the cost model and PO timeline once we pick the vendor(s)?

Thanks — happy to take a sync if helpful.

Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: endpoint_inventory_202605.csv (CSV, 1 file)
From: Alyssa Martinez <alyssa.martinez@sentineledge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MDM / EDR / Vuln Scanner License Consolidation — Request & Next Steps

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for reaching out and for the inventory. SentinelEdge would be very interested in participating in a consolidation evaluation. A few quick asks so we can prepare a meaningful proposal:
- Confirm current EDR agent counts by OS (Windows/Linux/macOS) and number of servers vs. endpoints. The attached inventory looks close but we may need the agent export.
- Any strict telemetry or retention SLAs (e.g., 90d vs 365d) and whether endpoint telemetry can be routed to a customer-managed S3 for long-term storage.
- Are there specific integration points required (SIEM, MDM APIs, EDR event webhooks)?

We can deliver a draft renewal + consolidation proposal and a technical appendix within 7–10 business days. I’m attaching a draft renewal outline for your review (SentinelEdge_renewal_draft.pdf).

Would suggest a 30-minute technical review with Mina and your IT team early next week — Tue/Wed preferable.

Best,
Alyssa Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | SentinelEdge
Attachments: SentinelEdge_renewal_draft.pdf

Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MDM / EDR / Vuln Scanner License Consolidation — Request & Next Steps

Alyssa / Tom / Team,

Thanks — quick technical constraints from security:
- Telemetry retention: EDR event store must be retained 365 days for investigation purposes. If vendor cannot host that long, we require an export path to customer-managed storage (S3) with documented schema and export frequency.
- Endpoint isolation: EDR must support on-host isolation and remote kill of suspicious processes.
- Enrollment: MDM must allow automated enrollment via SSO and support Apple DEP and Android Zero-Touch.
- Vulnerability scanning: scheduled scans without excessive agent CPU overhead; API to pull scan results into our vulnerability management dashboard (we use Jira for ticketing).
- Compliance artifacts: please provide a SOC 2 Type II report, PCI/ISO artifacts if available, and an outline of data flows for telemetry.

Also, please call out per-agent pricing bands (0-1k, 1k-5k, >5k) and any cross-product discounts. Procurement: we need vendor quotes that separate licensing, support, and professional services line items so we can model TCO.

I’m available Tue 6/9 10–11am PT for a technical call.

-Mina
Mina Haddad
Security Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

Team,

Post-call summary and commercial decision: after the technical review and the pricing scenarios from SentinelEdge, security confirms the solution meets non-negotiables (365d retention via S3 export, process isolation, enrollments). SentinelEdge’s consolidated scenario (EDR + Vuln addon) gives the most favorable blended TCO and removes one agent from endpoints in our pilot group.

Marissa / Procurement: please proceed to finalize the redlined quote and convert to PO. Alyssa — please kick off a DocuSign envelope for the consolidated agreement and include the commercial/PS line items as separate invoiceable rows. Link to vendor quote: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-456 (vendor docs uploaded).

Target: PO issued by 2026-06-17 so we can lock current pricing before the 08/15 renewal. If procurement sees any blocker (SOW, support SLA exceptions, or legal redlines), flag immediately and loop me in.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
